profile_text.body:
The Technology Innovation Institute (TII) is a government-backed scientific research center and the applied research pillar of Abu Dhabi's Advanced Technology Research Council (ATRC), founded in 2020. According to its website, TII describes itself as making "advanced AI accessible and available to everyone, everywhere" through the development and open-sourcing of generative AI models. The institute launched the Falcon Foundation, a non-profit organization dedicated to advancing open-source generative AI models and building sustainable ecosystems around open-source projects.

TII's primary AI product is the Falcon LLM family, a series of open-source large language models released under the Apache 2.0 license with weights available for both research and commercial use. The Falcon lineup includes Falcon 180B, trained on 3.5 trillion tokens with 180 billion parameters and ranked at the top of the Hugging Face Leaderboard for pre-trained open large language models, and Falcon 40B, trained on one trillion tokens with 40 billion parameters. More recent additions include Falcon 2 11B, described as open-source, multilingual, and multimodal with vision-to-language capabilities, Falcon-H1, which uses a hybrid Transformer and Mamba architecture, Falcon Arabic for Modern Standard Arabic and dialects, and Falcon Perception, a multimodal model for image understanding. The company also offers Falcon H1R 7B for reasoning tasks and Falcon Mamba 7B, described as the first open-source State Space Language Model.

TII's Falcon models are hosted on a UAE-based infrastructure reflecting a sovereign AI approach with Middle East data residency. The institute conducts community engagement through initiatives including the Falcon LLM Hackfest and a global Call for Proposals inviting developers and university researchers to submit use cases and problem-solving challenges for compute rewards.
